name: Overclocked
desc: Engineered by P.A.C.K. technicians, this vessel's power grid has been pushed far beyond safe factory specifications. The intensive tuning yields superior combat performance but requires constant maintenance, increasing supply maintenance cost by %s percent at maximum combat readiness.

name: Overclocked
desc: Engineered by P.A.C.K. technicians, this vessel's power grid has been pushed far beyond safe factory specifications. The intensive tuning yields superior combat performance but requires constant maintenance, increasing supply maintenance cost by %s percent at maximum combat readiness.

name: Overclocked
desc: A more aggressive variant of P.A.C.K. overclocking, stripping away safety limiters. Increases supply maintenance cost by %s percent at maximum combat readiness, and the intense mechanical stress reduces peak combat readiness duration by %s percent.
short: Increased performance and maintenance, reduced peak CR.

name: Pre-militarized Hullform
desc: A poorly executed attempt to bring a civilian vessel up to military standards. Improvised bulkheads and unshielded engine blocks counteract the benefits of mil-spec armor coatings, increasing the ship's sensor profile by %s percent.

name: Bullseye Suite
desc: A comprehensive aftermarket overhaul of the vessel's reactor and targeting computers. Designed by P.A.C.K. engineers for prolonged warfare, this suite significantly improves flux distribution and mobility systems.
sModDesc: Increases projectile speed by %s and weapon turn rate by %s.

name: ASP Syndicate Sponsored
desc: Maintained under a premium ASP Syndicate service contract. The hull gleams with a polished finish, and all internal systems are kept in immaculate, combat-ready condition, reflecting a substantial corporate investment.

name: Integrated Point Defense AI
desc: An integrated AI routine that dynamically slaves small weapons to a localized defense grid, granting all small non-missile weapons the ability to automatically track and engage incoming enemy missiles.
short: All small non-missile weapons act as point-defense.

name: Metastable Drive Field
desc:
Conventional wisdom dictates that a metastable drive is perfectly safe, provided it isn't pushed too far.

At high hard flux levels, this scavenged drive field destabilizes to provide a significant speed boost (up to %s percent). This deliberate instability is prone to catastrophic overloads, but makes the vessel remarkably easy to recover after a battle.
short: Speed boost at high flux, dangerous overloads.
sModDesc: Reduces overload duration by %s and decreases EMP damage taken by %s.

name: Shocking Behaviour
desc: Due to dangerously exposed flux coils and improvised power conduits, this module arcs back to parent station at high flux.

name: Octopus No Shields
desc: Attempting to install secondary generators would cause catastrophic phase interference, which prohibits shield hullmods, as the built in shield module does all the work.

name: Wibble Wobble
desc: A side effect of the Junk Pirates' notorious 'good enough' engineering. The gyroscopic stabilizers are slightly misaligned, which makes things go a bit wibbly wobbly.

name: Wobble Wibble
desc: A severe iteration of gyroscopic misalignment. The vessel's superstructure shudders violently under engine stress, which makes things go a bit wobbly wibbly.

name: Blue Zapper
desc: An experimental iteration of the metastable drive. It created a cascading wave of volatility that doomed several test crews. The project was abruptly canceled, but a few of these highly dangerous prototype drives remain in circulation.
short: Extreme speed boost at high flux, highly dangerous.

name: Born with a Silver Spanner
desc: The chaotic hierarchy of a Junk Pirates crew ensures the vessel remains operational long after warning klaxons have sounded. Their frantic, unconventional repairs result in %s higher maximum combat readiness, and a %s reduction in CR degradation once peak time has expired.

name: Survival Instincts
desc: Operated by a P.A.C.K. crew utilizing proprietary, arcane communication protocols. The resulting high-bandwidth network allows for superior tactical responsiveness and a vastly reduced electronic footprint, lowering the vessel's sensor profile to %s of its base value.

name: Corporate Discipline
desc: A tidy workspace yields a tidy profit. ASP Syndicate crews are renowned for their meticulous maintenance and strict organizational protocols. This professional upkeep results in a %s boost to overall combat readiness and a %s improvement in flux dissipation.

name: P.A.C.K. Mesh
desc:
The P.A.C.K. rely on a highly resilient, proprietary mesh network to coordinate deployments. When multiple ships utilizing this network are deployed together, they share processing power to boost the entire fleet.

Each unique hull class contributes its bonus once:

Frigate: +%s weapon range
Destroyer: -%s shield damage taken
Cruiser: +%s top speed

5+ unique hulls: -%s weapon flux cost
10+ unique hulls: +%s base flux capacity
short: Fleet bonuses based on diverse P.A.C.K. hulls deployed.
sModDesc: Increases base top speed by %s and reduces weapon flux cost by %s.

name: Scrap Damper (Passive)
desc: Passive localized structural fields permanently reduce damage taken by armor, hull, and EMP by %s. When the ships Scrap Damper system is active, this total reduction scales up to %s.
